buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Expander Specification. 1.1. For water drum 35mm + 8mm one stage expander 1.2. For steam drum 80mm + 8mm two stage expander 1.3. Specification. Thee roll precision with replaceable rolls, hardness, Mandrel, anti slip design, concentri c specification, compatibity with pneumatic/ electric drives and controlled expansion without tube scoring

or over thinning. Minimum 25 successful expansion per expander, stable torque, no gailing no seizure, no roll failure, dimensional accuracy. Blackodizing or hot cold black oxide coating on Tube expanders for rust prevention. 2. Material. Mandrel- H13/EN31 vacuum hardened 58-62 HRC Rolls- M2HSS 60-64 HRC (Taper or mandrel and roller to be checked on sign bar) Thrust collar assembly material EN-8 with 25RC fixed on expander for adjusting length as per drum thickness 3. Capacity assessment. Mandatory in-house CAD-CAM, CNC tuning, CNC machining centerless, cylindr ical/ centerless grinders, vaccum heat treatment, stress relieving, tempering, CMM laboratory, Calibrated Metrology and traceability 4. Inspection facility. Rockwell Vickers hardness tester, UTM, metallurgical microscope, MPI, DPI, ultraso nic flaw detection, roundness tester, roughness tester, concentricity measuring equipment, dedicated exp ansion simulation with interchangeable tube sheets, torque measurement, RPM, Trust/ load measurement, hydraulic/ pneumatic drive. 5. Inspection stages. Incoming material inspection Process Inspection Dimensional verification Heat treatment verification In process records Surface finish FInal inspection Functional test FAT witness (expansion of representative tube, leak test, wear test, calibration verification and acceptance user) 6. Document to be submitted. GA drawing, manufacturing drawing, heat treatment certificate hardne ss report, inspection report, calibration certificate, operation and maintenance manual, illustrated spare pa rt catalogue, warranty certificate, FAT report. 7. Packing and preservation. Rust preventive coating, vaccum packing, shock resistance export quality wooden cases, identification labels. 8. Warranty. 12 Months from the date of receipt or 25 tube expansion whichever is earlier. 9. Delivery. Supply complete material along with calibration certificate within 60 days receipt of forma l supply order. 10. Acceptance criterial. Acceptance only after satisfactory FAT, document review, dimensional complia nce, functional demonstration and purchaser approval. 11. Knockout rod specification . 11.1. Material. B17 M4D/AISI 4340 (refined forged steel) 11.2. Hardened and temperature. 48-50 Rc 12. Tube wall Gauge. Boiler tube wall thickness ranges from 2.5 mm (min) to 3.5mm (max). 13. Minimum Qualification Requirements. 13.1. Financial Capacity. The firm should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 32,45,896.80 over the last three financial years ending with 31 Mar 25. Proof is to be submitted along with the technical bid. (CA audited turnover/ IT returns). Firm should also submit annual turnover for the last three financial y ears ending 31 Mar 25. 13.2. Pre- qualification requirement. The firm shall possess minimum five years id experience in manufa cturing of tube expanders and knockout for IBR/ASME boiler with working pressure of 64 bar to 96 bar use d in marine/ Naval/ refinery or Thermal power plants with high pressure boilers. Documentary evidence ha s to submit with T-Bid.
*Note: Para 8.1, 8.2 and 8.3 of Gem bid doc for Minimum value of work order will be exempted for MSME fi rm. .
